payload.claim: `run_rebuttal` gained a new required `spec_id` parameter whose sole stated purpose is to tag the re-prompt's own `PhaseStart` (per the comment at line 232-234: 'this turn authors its own re-prompt PhaseStart below'). No test anywhere in the diff asserts the emitted event's `spec_id` field actually equals the value passed in. Hardcoding `spec_id="SA-9999"` in place of `spec_id=spec_id` at this call site would leave every new witness (in tests/test_rebut.py and tests/test_session.py) green: they check `event.phase`, `event.label` and `event.detail`, never `event.spec_id`. Since `EventLog.append` performs no validation against the task directory, a wrong or stale spec_id here would silently misattribute the line in any multiplexed view (`saffron watch` with no task id), and nothing in this suite would catch it.
